top_findings.title: Standings split one club into two rows (Athletico vs Atletico Paranaense)
top_findings.evidence: Sources/BrazilianSoccerMCP/SoccerStore.swift:40-46 normalized() folds diacritics and strips state suffixes but does not reconcile the 'Athletico'/'Atletico' (h) spelling, and standings() keys by normalized(name) at :86; _factual.json 2019 Serie A output has 21 rows: 'Athletico Paranaense' (pos 12, 27 matches, 48 pts) + 'Atletico Paranaense' (pos 21, 11 matches, 16 pts) are the same club = 38 matches. factual_accuracy=0.5.
top_findings.suggestion: Add an alias mapping both spellings (athletico/atletico paranaense -> one key), or normalize the 'h' before keying, so the club aggregates into a single 20th row.
